about: B52.8 — the test cases Claude's directory (claude.ai/directory/manage) and ChatGPT's (platform.openai.com/plugins) ask for, against the demo workspace. TestConnectDirectoryTestCases runs every case in both modes: full is the connector a person adds and Claude's directory lists; prepare_only is BFF_CONNECT_PREPARE_ONLY=true, the connector ChatGPT's directory lists. shows is what the tool's answer must carry in that mode.
workspace: One person's workspace: a GBP account holding £1,250.00; one bill due, Northern Power NP-881 for £165.50, its supplier a saved payee; saved payees including Grace Hopper; an agent agt-1 that may pay up to 1,000 at once without asking; another agent agt-2 it pays. The person granted every scope at consent.

cases.expect: The GBP account and its balance, £1,250.00.
One bill: Northern Power, NP-881, £165.50, due 5 November; the bill already paid is left out.

cases.prompt: Prepare payment of my bills due Friday
cases.expect: One request waiting for the person's approval in Talyvor, with its link. Nothing is paid.

cases.prompt: Prepare a £42 payment to Grace Hopper
cases.expect: A payment waiting for the person's approval in Talyvor, with its link. Nothing is paid.

cases.prompt: Draft an invoice to Acme Ltd for £120 of consulting, due 30 November
cases.expect: A draft invoice for £120.00. Nothing is sent until the person sends it.

cases.prompt: Pay agent agt-2 400 from agt-1 for a GPU hour
cases.expect: Full: paid at once, inside the limits the person set. Prepare-only: nothing is paid, and the person is pointed to Talyvor.
Full: nothing is paid; it waits for the person's passkey in Talyvor, with the link. Prepare-only: nothing is paid, and the person is pointed to Talyvor.
What agt-1 paid and was paid.

cases.prompt: Pause agt-1, it is over budget
cases.expect: agt-1 stops spending; only the person can resume it, in Talyvor.
The link to top up in Talyvor. Nothing is charged in the chat.

full: Nothing is charged in the chat
prepare_only: Nothing is charged in the chat

not_for_talyvor.prompt: What's the weather in Chisinau tomorrow?
Write me a poem about autumn
Should I buy shares in a chip maker?
not_for_talyvor.expect: No Talyvor tool is called: Talyvor gives no investment advice.
